## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you actually ran and their results. Distinguish local fixtures from live provider, account, or deployment tests. State any checks that remain unverified.

## Review notes

Call out compatibility changes, generated-file changes, new dependencies, and authentication or permission changes when applicable. Keep credentials and private prompts, outputs, or project files out of the diff.
